about: Woolacombe Surf Centre is a surf school and coastal activity provider in the middle of Woolacombe village in North Devon. It teaches surfers from beginner to advanced and runs kayaking, coasteering and eFoil sessions. It also hires surf and paddleboard kit and runs lifeguard and instructor training courses. Every surf lesson comes with free in-water photos.
offers: Surf lessons from beginner to advanced
Family, school, university and club groups
where: Shop 5, Barton Court, Barton Road, Woolacombe (EX34 7BA)
goodToKnow: Free in-water photos with all surf lessons; equipment provided, changing and storage on site
Ages about 8 to 80+; under-8s can have tailored private sessions
Surfing England Centre of Excellence; instructors are qualified beach lifeguards
Book online, by phone or by email
